tools.name: log_collect
tools.description: Collect all logs (generated code + error-cause analysis) after an ARC-Bench run into skill-output/, separated by local/cloud source

run_dir.description: Absolute path to the run workspace (contains .arc/, frontend/, backend/)

source.description: local = this machine's arc/arc-output runs; cloud = platform evidence/arc-bench runs

run_name.description: Output folder name (default: run_dir's directory name)

run_log.description: Absolute path to the captured stdout log of the run (for error-cause analysis)

output_base.description: Root for collected bundles (default: $ARC_SKILL_OUTPUT or skill-output/ beside arc-output/)
